summary: The candidates in this set are primarily categorized as systemic therapies or procedural details. Several medications (lisinopril, calcium carbonate, dexamethasone) and the lymph node dissection procedure show strong dual roles as confounders and effect modifiers. Others, such as cisplatin and G12C inhibitors, act primarily as effect modifiers. Gemcitabine is identified as a confounder. Morphological features like m_stage demonstrate effect modification and prognostic value.
